authority_basis.summary: Notify Nima of the physical q_G A1 threefold-node result.

operations.title: Benincasa derives the physical four-site q_G vanishing-cycle germ
operations.body: Entry 1168/event 935 computes the local physical q_G singularity. In chart y4=1, the Jacobian from projective deviations to Delta has det -8. The branch quadratic is -1/4 u^T J^T adj(G) J u with Hessian determinant -8 det(G)^2. Hence away from existing Gram support the quartic double solid has a complex-threefold A1 node, Milnor number 1, and a rank-one H3 vanishing cycle. Local monodromy fixes the vanishing line, though the ambient H3 may carry a Picard-Lefschetz transvection. Next is the source radial-chain strict transform and its integral exceptional boundary.
